sections.decision: Current official available-data policy grants CC BY4.0 use with attribution. Not an invented universal prohibition on scientific calculation. Existing metadata R/NR describes historical author spreadsheet access separately and does not itself prove current embargo or relicense it.

Retain Neotoma database citation, European Pollen Database citation, primary investigator/publications, each dataset DOI and retrieval date. Original primary publication attribution still must be fetched or identified before a durable scientific publication.
Inspect actual snapshot/native metadata for access/location restrictions. Public retrieval status cannot override a real restriction; none inferred from absent fields. No external message is sent.
Consider contributor/steward coauthorship when substantive; CC BY does not require invitation permission, and no authorship attribution without consent.
